python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Data for Rural Electrification Administration (1961-1970) in millions of dollars
values = [3332, 3424, 3657, 3828, 4075, 4234, 4518, 4770, 5045, 5328]

n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n

print(f"Values: {values}")
print(f"Number of observations: {n}")
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

# Calculate Theil index of dispersion
# T = (1/n) * Σ[(y_i / ȳ) * ln(y_i / ȳ)]
theil_sum = 0
for v in values:
    ratio = v / mean
    theil_sum += ratio * math.log(ratio)

theil_index = theil_sum / n

print(f"\nTheil index of dispersion: {theil_index}")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(theil_index, 3)}")
EOF

import math

# Data for Rural Electrification Administration (1961-1970) in millions of dollars
values = [3332, 3424, 3657, 3828, 4075, 4234, 4518, 4770, 5045, 5328]

n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n

# Alternative formula: Theil-T = (1/n) * Σ[(y_i / ȳ) * ln(y_i / ȳ)]
# Also equals: (1/n) * Σ[ln(ȳ / y_i)] = mean * Σ[ln(ȳ / y_i)] / sum of all values

# Let's verify using the second form: (1/n) * Σ[ln(ȳ / y_i)]
theil_l_sum = 0
for v in values:
    theil_l_sum += math.log(mean / v)

theil_l = theil_l_sum / n
print(f"Theil-L (Mean Log Deviation): {theil_l:.10f}")

# And the original Theil-T
theil_t_sum = 0
for v in values:
    ratio = v / mean
    theil_t_sum += ratio * math.log(ratio)

theil_t = theil_t_sum / n
print(f"Theil-T: {theil_t:.10f}")

# Both should give positive value for Theil-T (inequality measure)
print(f"\nRounded to 3 decimal places: {round(theil_t, 3)}")
